ios.desc:
Country facts, ready whenever curiosity strikes.
World Book brings the final public archive of the CIA World Factbook to your pocket — fast and distraction-free.
Explore 260+ countries and territories, spin an interactive 3D globe, and compare 100+ global rankings.
Read country profiles, flags, and rankings offline. Photos and regional maps download as you explore, then stay available offline.
Buy once. No ads, tracking, or subscriptions.

---

3D INTERACTIVE GLOBE
• Fluid 3D globe visualization powered by vector mapping
• Spin, zoom, and explore every sovereign nation and territory
• Tap any country’s flag annotation to dive straight into in-depth profiles

100+ GLOBAL METRIC RANKINGS
• Compare nations across key metrics: GDP, population, life expectancy, energy, and communications
• Sort, filter, and analyze comparative leaderboards across the globe
• Tap or drag across interactive charts to compare reported values, dates, and ranks

COMPREHENSIVE COUNTRY PROFILES
• Detailed facts for 260+ countries and territories
• Deep-dive chapters: Geography, People & Society, Government, Economy, Energy, Communications, Transportation, and Military
• Public-domain photo galleries showcasing national landscapes and landmarks

HIGH-RESOLUTION REGIONAL MAPS
• Vector regional maps covering Africa, Americas, Asia, Europe, Middle East, Polar Regions, and Oceans
• Full-bleed zoom with zero blur or pixelation
• World Time Zone reference map included

INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS DIRECTORY
• Comprehensive reference for global bodies (UN, EU, NATO, ASEAN, OECD, OPEC, and more)
• Instantly view member states, observer countries, and regional alliances

TAILORED READING EXPERIENCE
• Comfortable reading with Bariol at 115% by default, plus Tisa Mobi Pro and adjustable fonts
• Reading themes (Light, Sepia, Gray, Night) with custom font sizes and line heights
• Quick-jump Table of Contents and full iOS Spotlight search integration

OFFLINE READING & PRIVATE
• Country text, flags, rankings, locator maps, and the globe are bundled for offline reading
• Photos download on demand; regional maps download automatically or when opened. Downloaded media remains available offline.
• Buy once, own forever — zero ads, zero tracking, no in-app purchases, and no subscriptions

World Book is an independent reference reader, not affiliated with or endorsed by the CIA. Content is archived, not live, and figures may refer to different years. The interface is English-only.
